probe: sf-chat-window against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.9 §12, gate 20); the behaviour simai/ui-chat's tests/chat-window.test.mjs and tests/browser/staff.test.mjs hold for it: the port data drawn by the parts, a send without a port answered by answer(), the port through connect-port, capabilities not offered, a cancelled event, a proposal, a rating, the archive and its way back, «Мои файлы», the search, a revoked feed and the greeting
format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

probes.title: set-data hands the port data to the parts: the list shows the conversations with the open one selected, the log draws each message as an sf-chat-message (the question, the answer with its markup), the header names the conversation, the chat words reach the parts (thread-list «Новый разговор»)
probes.covers: actions.set-data, settings.conversations, settings.conversation, settings.messages, renderMessage, part-words
